title: Microbial eukaryotic 18S tag-sequence processing/QC - V4 region (automating)
author: Sarah K Hu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j9bcr2n

steps.title: Prepare Environment and Required Files
steps.instruction: Install necessary software and prepare the input files and reference databases.

substeps.instruction: Install QIIME (v1.9.1 or higher), fastqjoin (or PEAR), Trimmomatic (v0.32), and vsearch (v1.11.1).
Create a text file named 'prefix.txt' containing a list of file prefixes for the demultiplexed raw fastq files.
Generate a fasta file named 'trimPE_V4primer.fasta' containing the V4 primer sequences (Stoeck et al. 2010).
Acquire a reference database (e.g., PR2 database formatted for QIIME).

steps.title: Generate QIIME Mapping Files
steps.instruction: Create QIIME-formatted map files based on the prefix list to facilitate sequence processing.

substeps.instruction: Run the Perl script './create.map.pl' using 'prefix.txt' as input to generate individual '_map.txt' files for each sample.

steps.title: Perform Sequence Quality Control
steps.instruction: Process each sample individually through a series of trimming, merging, and filtering steps.

substeps.instruction: Trim primers and low-quality bases using Trimmomatic (v0.32) with parameters: LEADING:10, TRAILING:10, SLIDINGWINDOW:10:30, MINLEN:50, and ILLUMINACLIP using 'trimPE_V4primer.fasta:2:30:10'.
Merge paired-end (R1 and R2) reads using 'join_paired_ends.py' with a 20 bp overlap (-j 20).
Filter sequences by quality score using 'split_libraries_fastq.py' with a Q score threshold of 30 (-q 29).
Filter sequences by length using the script 'seqlength_cutoff.pl' with a minimum length of 150 and a maximum length of 500.
Perform a chimera check using 'vsearch --uchime_ref' against the reference database (e.g., PR2) with the strand set to 'plus'.

steps.title: Aggregate Processed Reads
steps.instruction: Combine the cleaned, non-chimera sequences from all samples into a single master file.

substeps.instruction: Concatenate all '_trim_merged_Q30_len_nc.fasta' files into a single file named 'allseqs_test.fasta' using the 'cat' command.

steps.title: Perform OTU Clustering and Taxonomy Assignment
steps.instruction: Cluster the aggregated sequences into Operational Taxonomic Units (OTUs) and assign taxonomy.

substeps.instruction: Run 'pick_open_reference_otus.py' using 'allseqs_test.fasta' and the PR2 reference database with the uclust method, suppressing step 4 and taxonomy assignment.
Assign taxonomy to the representative set using 'assign_taxonomy.py' with the PR2 database (ids.names.2.txt and pr2.qiime.fasta) and uclust method.
Generate an OTU table using 'make_otu_table.py' based on the final OTU map and taxonomy assignments.
Convert the resulting .biom file to a TSV text file using 'biom convert' with the header key set to taxonomy.
